# Airbnb (ABNB) Research Brief
*Data as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.*

## Bottom line
Airbnb is trading at $157.47 with a market cap of $94.29B and a trailing 12-month P/E of 35.04, reflecting positive recent daily momentum of +4.02% despite a bearish overall tone in recent news coverage regarding broader industry and technological shifts.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $157.47 |
| Today's move | +4.02% |
| 52-week range | $110.81 - $193.45 (56% of the way from the 52-week low to the high) |
| Market cap | $94.29B |
| P/E (trailing 12 months) | 35.04 |
| Revenue growth (year over year) | +13.6% |

## What's in the news
The tone of recent media coverage is bearish.
- The company experienced a notable single-day drop of nearly 8% amidst discussions about where valuations might head through the year 2026 ([Airbnb Stock Fell Nearly 8% in a Day. Here’s Where the Stock Could Go in 2026](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=850232a3f0f671c325529e538935abe1cb675c2156a9969e728a7bf665c8f18d) - Yahoo, 2026-09-24)
- Shares retreated toward the $150 level as market participants expressed anxiety that artificial intelligence advancements might bypass traditional platform intermediaries ([Airbnb Slides to $150 as Wall Street Fears AI Will Skip the Middleman](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=85258c6c7e5d93abd030ebc370a30de270c63219481026855a9918be65407217) - Yahoo, 2026-09-24)

## Things to watch
- The valuation multiple, indicated by a trailing P/E of 35.04, sits alongside a year-over-year revenue growth rate of +13.6%, raising questions about how much future expansion is currently priced into the shares.
- Market concerns highlighted in recent headlines regarding artificial intelligence potentially bypassing traditional intermediaries point to longer-term structural uncertainties for the platform model.

## Sources
- Price and fundamentals: Finnhub (quote and company metrics), as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.
- News: the linked articles above, from Finnhub company news (last 7 days).

## Disclaimer
This is informational research only, not investment advice.

# Bloom Energy (BE) Research Brief
*Data as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.*

## Bottom line
Bloom Energy shares are experiencing strong upward momentum, driven by significant positive market reactions and reaffirmations of key commercial agreements. The company's valuation reflects high growth expectations, supported by robust year over year revenue expansion and active media coverage focusing on its AI-related energy infrastructure deals.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $288.70 |
| Today's move | +8.27% |
| 52-week range | $61.37 - $351.28 (78% of the way from the 52-week low to the high) |
| Market cap | $85.03B |
| P/E (trailing 12 months) | 347.14 |
| Revenue growth (year over year) | +91.0% |

## What's in the news
The overall tone of recent media coverage is bullish.
- Bloom Energy shares moved higher alongside other equities as artificial intelligence sector sentiment rebounded ([Bloom Energy, TSM Lead 5 Stocks Near Buy Points As AI Rebounds](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=1560d83ed6c44c45e99f6a683f237932b0d56fb264c41ffd777e5c2dab3d4eaa) - Yahoo, 2026-09-26)
- The company's stock experienced notable upward movement as part of a broader group of soaring industrial and tech-adjacent shares ([Fluence Energy, Generac, Bloom Energy, Columbus McKinnon, and Viavi Solutions Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=248792012d2d02585e9bf3a6af15a7f86798ee706a6e6ad9803217c17d6f859a) - Yahoo, 2026-09-26)
- Bloom Energy climbed after Oracle reaffirmed its commitment to a large artificial intelligence fuel cell agreement following a force majeure notice ([Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 8.7% After Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW AI Fuel Cell Deal Commitment – Has The Bull Case Changed?](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=bc92f47df2a597a54174a2fc21f251751fe09d36d8e1bbaee6b61edd90d8d080) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)
- Strong performance landed Bloom Energy as a top S&P 500 performer, largely driven by developments surrounding Oracle ([Bloom Energy Stock Is Today’s Top S&P 500 Performer. It Has a Lot to Do With Oracle.](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=536697f03e2f5be9133ee46ad0389ea71a1084d6aa45b6c5893474c08a761465) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)
- The fuel cell contract was reaffirmed, prompting a jump in share price despite earlier project jitters ([Bloom Energy Jumps 8% as Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW Fuel Cell Contract After Force Majeure Notice](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=72eefe0f81b501e479bfe442814e566c12e9c2badba9a9ef82c4455b2ef23e7e) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)

## Things to watch
- The trailing P/E ratio sits at an elevated level while year over year revenue growth is rapid, making it worth watching how the company sustains its valuation relative to its expansion pace.
- Recent headlines highlight large-scale dependencies such as the Oracle fuel cell agreement, emphasizing the importance of monitoring contract execution and managing potential project disruptions.
- The share price is positioned well within its 52-week range toward the upper boundary, directing attention to how the market reacts to ongoing sector volatility.

## Sources
- Price and fundamentals: Finnhub (quote and company metrics), as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.
- News: the linked articles above, from Finnhub company news (last 7 days).

This is informational research only, not investment advice.

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|

- New research coverage from financial institutions includes positive investment ratings and an initial price target of $100 ([Seaport Global Initiates Coverage On ON Semiconductor with Buy Rating, Announces Price Target of $100](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=bec1c5a8a8407044cfc274db4e0cc7329befee82391dafba4544f6da7e74126e) - Benzinga, 2026-09-23)

# PayPal (PYPL) Research Brief
*Data as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.*

## Bottom line
PayPal shares show strong positive momentum with recent gains, trading at a lower valuation relative to earnings while posting positive top-line growth. Recent media coverage is bullish, driven by renewed buyout speculation and strategic partnership announcements.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $55.04 |
| Today's move | +4.64% |
| 52-week range | $38.46 - $79.22 (41% of the way from the 52-week low to the high) |
| Market cap | $47.08B |
| P/E (trailing 12 months) | 9.61 |
| Revenue growth (year over year) | +5.7% |

## What's in the news
The overall tone of recent media coverage is bullish.

- PayPal shares experienced upward movement driven by renewed acquisition chatter following another potential bidder exiting the field ([PYPL Stock Climbs On West Coast Takeover Rumors After Stripe Walk-Away Leaves Room For A New Bidder](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=8c6bcafb7d356ab710d80b77e4ee086f434b400ad7f307411200f45bd498645d) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)
- Takeover chatter resurfaced around the company, drawing fresh market attention ([PYPL Stock Alert: What to Know as PayPal Takeover Rumors Restart](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=b3f988d378a22dbb3489f4ebc9128a7fbafd3d845de87c47370ddaf25dce8154) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)
- The stock saw noticeable jumps as market participants reacted to new acquisition speculation ([PayPal Stock Jumps on Fresh Takeover Chatter After Stripe Walks Away](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=85369f16204d70925f5b8579336c70269e84d4e6f17cd46589cba2cb1f259020) - Yahoo, 2026-09-25)
- The company announced a significant artificial intelligence shopping agreement with Meta ([PayPal Strikes Major Meta AI Shopping Deal](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=e77d4e9973b603646e16f9fb78139998e8b5a9f65caedd6b39d0174299d46cb5) - Yahoo, 2026-09-24)

## Things to watch
- The stock trades near the lower half of its yearly price range despite positive earnings valuation metrics and active deal speculation.
- Open questions remain regarding whether the renewed acquisition chatter will materialize into formal takeover bids or if the company will continue independently.
- The execution and financial impact of the newly announced artificial intelligence shopping partnership are key operational points to monitor alongside steady top-line expansion.

## Sources
- Price and fundamentals: Finnhub (quote and company metrics), as of 28 Sep 2026, 10:48 UTC.
- News: the linked articles above, from Finnhub company news (last 7 days).

## Disclaimer
This is informational research only, not investment advice.
